title: Star Catcher
hook: 天上掉下一颗小星星，Dora 要把它们收进星星口袋，再一路送到云中城堡。

cells.en: Dora catches a little star under the big green tree.
cells.cn: Dora 在大绿树下接住了一颗小星星。

cells.en: Boots wants to put the star in the star pocket.
cells.cn: Boots 想把星星放进星星口袋里。

cells.en: Map says: water, mountain, then the cloud castle.
cells.cn: 地图说：先水路，再上山，最后到云中城堡。

cells.en: A little star walks to the boat on the dock.
cells.cn: 一颗小星星走到码头的小船边。

cells.en: Dora takes the wheel and drives the boat across.
cells.cn: Dora 握住舵轮，开着船过河。

cells.en: Now they see Dragon Mountain with many stars around.
cells.cn: 这会儿他们看见了恐龙山，周围全是星星。

cells.en: Switchy can fill in the missing shapes on the box.
cells.cn: 星星 Switchy 会把盒子上缺的形状补好。

cells.en: Look up! There is a castle in the clouds.
cells.cn: 抬头看！云里有一座城堡。

cells.en: The king says, “You are a great star catcher!”
cells.cn: 国王说：“你真是了不起的抓星星高手！”

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Star Catcher”.
ending: In the end, Dora brings every star to the cloud castle. My favorite part is ______.
